y-m-69-02.title: Mukombe wakadhirowa nerwodzi nemapegi maviri
y-m-69-02.topic: Tsananguro yeellipse (huwandu hwemadaro kubva pamapoinzi maviri)
y-m-69-02.goal: Kumukombe wakadhirowa nemapegi maviri nerwodzi, gadzirisa kufungidzira kwako sezvo ruzivo rwuchipiwa chidimbu nechidimbu, sarudza kuti mamiriro e 'huwandu hwemadaro hwakagara' anogadzira chimiro chipi, kusanganisira nyaya umo mukombe usingagoni kudhirowa, uye ugadzire wega mapoinzi anokodzera mamiriro.
y-m-69-02.material: Murimi anovhiringidza mapegi maviri muvhu ari 6 m kupatsanurwa (F ne F′) uye anosunga migumo miviri yerwodzi rwe10 m kumapegi. Achidhonza rwodzi rwakasimba nemhino yenyanga, murimi anotenderera kudhirowa mukombe. Rudaidza poinzi iri pamhino yenyanga P. Rwodzi runopatsanuka kuita zvikamu zviviri, PF ne PF′, uye marefu ezvikamu zviviri anogara achiwedzera kuita 10 m. Rega O ive pakati pesegment FF′.
y-m-69-02.thinking.0: Gadzirisa kufungidzira kwako neruzivo rwunopiwa nhanho nenhanho
y-m-69-02.prereq.0: Daro pakati pemapoinzi maviri nePythagorean theorem
y-m-69-02.prereq.1: Maitiro ekuwana macoordinates emapoinzi nemadaro pacoordinate plane
y-m-69-02.prereq.2: Kuva wakaziviswa ellipse se 'seti yemapoinzi ane madaro anowedzera kuita mwero wakagara' (kunyange kana usati wazviziva, unogona kuteedzera basa iri kubva patsananguro dzaro)
y-m-69-02.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo rwunoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kufungidzira uchishandisa zvaunoziva zvino chete, uye uongorore kuti kufungidzira kwako kunochinja sei nekuda kweruzivo rwakaratidzwa.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, siyanisa kana ruzivo rwakadzidzwa nyowani runopfupisa chiyero chehurefu kana rwunogadzika kukosha kwahwo.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa hurefu hwerwodzi nedaro pakati pemapegi uye ufungidzire mamiriro umo mukombe unogadzirwa.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Mapegi ari 6 m kupatsanurwa uye rwodzi i10 m. Isa segment FF′ nepamutsetse wakachinjika, uye rega h ive daro kubva ku O kusvika papoinzi iri kure zvikuru yaunosvika mukombe munzira perpendicular nesegment FF′ (kumusoro).
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Fungidzira h uchishandisa zvaunoziva zvino chete.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Haugoni kuziva kukosha chaiko; unogona kupa chiyero chete. Kana mhino yenyanga iri pakarepo pamusoro pe O uye zvikamu zviviri zverwodzi zvakareba zvakafanana, chikamu chimwe nechimwe i5 m, saka h inofanira kuva pfupi kupfuura 5 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatonga nekuenzanisa ne3 m chete, hafu yedaro pakati pemapegi. Hausati wafunga kuti hurefu hwe10 m hwerwodzi hunokanganisa sei h.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: h i3 m kana kupfuura uye inenge 5 m kana pasi
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafungidzira chiyero uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti rwodzi rwakapatsanurwa kuita zvikamu zviviri.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Pangava pawakasabatanidza chokwadi chekuti rwodzi rwose i10 m nechikamu chega chega chinenge 5 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakangwarira: haushayi kukosha chaiko ukamirira ruzivo rwakawanda.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Poinzi yepamusoro zvikuru T yemukombe iri pakarepo pamusoro pe O. Sezvo T ichienzana kuruboshwe nekurudyi, TF=TF′, uye zvikamu zviviri zvinowedzera kuita 10 m, saka chimwe nechimwe i5 m. Zvakare OF=3 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino, h (hurefu kubva ku O kusvika ku T) i marii?
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Mutriangle OFT, OF=3, FT=5, uye kona yakarurama iri pa O. Saka h=√(5²−3²)=4 m. Kufungidzira kwako kwenhanho yekutanga kwe5 m kana pasi kwakarurama, uye zvino kukosha kwagadzikwa.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaverenga hurefu hwechikamu chimwe cherwodzi zvakananga sehurefu. Chikamu icho chiri pakatsvedza.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakangobvisa 3 m kubva pa5 m. Hauna kudhirowa kuti mativi api etriangle yakarurama marefu matatu aya.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti mapoinzi matatu O, F ne T anogadzira triangle yakarurama.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Pangava pawakashaya kuti ruzivo rwesymmetry runogadzika hurefu.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Chinja rwodzi kuita 6 m uye udhirowe nenzira imwe chete. Hurefu hwerwodzi hunoenzana nedaro re6 m pakati pemapegi.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mukombe wakadhirowa nemhino yenyanga une chimiro chipi?
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana P iri pasegment FF′, saka PF+PF′=6, asi pamapoinzi ari kunze kwesegment, PF+PF′ yakakura kupfuura 6. Saka kana rwodzi rwuri 6 m, segment FF′ pachayo ndiyo mukombe wose. Ellipse inoonekwa chete kana rwodzi rwakareba kupfuura 6 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaenderera netsika yekuti chimiro chinova chakati sandara sezvo rwodzi ruchipfupika. Hauna kufunga kana chimiro che 'ellipse' pachacho chichichengetwa kumugumo.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti PF+PF′ haigoni kuva pasi pe FF′.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti mukombe unova mudiki sezvo rwodzi ruchipfupika. Wakashaya kuti mapegi ari kure kubva kune mumwe.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakasanganisa mukombe une mapoinzi ose padaro rimwe chete kubva papoinzi imwe (denderedzwa) nemukombe umo huwandu hwemadaro kubva pamapoinzi maviri hwakagara.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.info: Panguva ino, chinja rwodzi kuita 5 m. Daro pakati pemapegi rinoramba i6 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.after: Kune poinzi P chero ipi, PF+PF′ inofanira kuva 6 kana kupfuura (huwandu hwemativi maviri hwakakura kana kuenzana nedivi rechitatu) FF′=6. Kana rwodzi rwuri 5 m, haugoni kunyange kurudhonza rwakasimba nemigumo yarwo miviri yakasungwa kumapegi, saka hapana mukombe unodhirowa.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Wakangoenderera netsika yekuti mukombe unova mudiki sezvo rwodzi ruchipfupika.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Wakacherekedza kuti rwodzi haruzogoni kuvhara daro re6 m pakati pemapegi maviri.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Wakashandisa chimiro chakaonekwa nerwodzi rwe6 m zvakananga kurwodzi rwe5 m.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Wakatarisa mamiriro mamwe erwodzi panzvimbo pechokwadi chekuti rwodzi haruzogoni kuvhara kupatsanurwa pakati pemapegi.
y-m-69-02.s.s1.reflect: Ellipse yaigona kudhirowa chete kana hurefu hwerwodzi (huwandu hwemadaro) hwakakura kupfuura daro pakati pemapegi; kana yakaenzana yaiva segment, uye kana iri diki haigoni kudhirowa. Sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzera, 'kufungidzira kwechiyero' kwako kwekutanga kwakarurama, asi kukosha kwakagadzikwa chete mushure mekushandisa symmetry netriangle yakarurama. Taura kuti kufungidzira kwako kwakachinja papi uye kwakaramba kwakafanana papi.
y-m-69-02.s.s2.prompt: Mipikiri iri pa F(−3, 0) ne F′(3, 0), uye rwodzi rurefu 10 m (yuniti yehurefu: m). Gadzira mapoinzi 3 P(x, y) ane y>0 pamukombe, ane absolute values dze x dzakasiyana. (Unogona kunyora madhesimali. Poinzi inoverengwa sei pamukombe kana huwandu hwemadaro kumipikiri miviri hwakaenzana ne10 mukati me0.02.)
y-m-69-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza P imwe kutanga, wana daro rayo kuna pegi imwe neimwe, uye uongorore huwandu.
y-m-69-02.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekugadzika x, chinja y zvishoma nezvishoma uye uwane kwahunova 10 huwandu hwemadaro.
y-m-69-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwemadaro kumipikiri miviri hunosiyana ne10 nekupfuura 0.02. Wana poinzi iri pamukombe.
y-m-69-02.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, (0, 4), (3, 3.2) ne (4, 2.4). Pa (0, 4) madaro kumapegi i5 ne5; pa (3, 3.2) i3.2 ne6.8; pa (4, 2.4) i2.6 ne7.4, saka huwandu hwose i10. (−3, 3.2) ipoinzi yerudzi rumwe chete, ine symmetry ne (3, 3.2) kuruboshwe nekurudyi.

y-m-69-09.title: Area yerumvuri rwe panel yakarerekera
y-m-69-09.goal: Ronga ruzivo rwunodiwa nerusingadiwi kuwana area ye orthogonal projection ye rectangle yakarerekera, gadzira makukwirira akati wandei anoenderana nemamiriro, uye uedze fungidziro yekuti 'painonyanya kukura kurerekera, ndipo painonyanya kukura rumvuri' nenhamba.
y-m-69-09.material: Wakamisa solar panel i rectangle ine upamhi 2 m nekureba 3 m (area 6 m²). Pamativi e 3 m, divi repasi rinobata pasi pakaenzana, uye divi repamusoro riri h m (0<h<3) pamusoro pepasi. Mativi ese e 2 m i parallel nepasi. Fungidzira kuti chiedza chezuva chinodonha perpendicular kupasi, uye ngatitii S i area yerumvuri (orthogonal projection) rwunogadzirwa ne panel pasi.
y-m-69-09.thinking.1: Kugadzira mitengo yakati wandei inoenderana nemamiriro
y-m-69-09.prereq.1: Area ye rectangle, nemaitiro ekuwana kureba kwe base ye right triangle kubva pa hypotenuse nekukwirira
y-m-69-09.prereq.2: Tsika yekuti kana chiedza chinodonha perpendicular kupasi, rumvuri rwechimiro runonzi 'orthogonal projection' yacho
y-m-69-09.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuwana S. Sarudza ruzivo rwese runotevera runobatsira kusarudza S. (Kunze kwehukuru hwaunoziva kare, rumwe neruzivo rwekuwedzera pachawo.)
y-m-69-09.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira panel ichionekwa kubva kudivi (right triangle) uye uone kuti mutengo upi unosarudza mativi asara.
y-m-69-09.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti ruzivo rupi runova rusina basa nekuda kwefungidziro yekuti chiedza chezuva i perpendicular kupasi.
y-m-69-09.s.s1.o.a: Nzira yemakwara apo panel inotarisa (kumabvazuva, kumadokero, kumaodzanyemba, kuchamhembe)
y-m-69-09.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti nzira inokanganisa area yerumvuri. Pasi pefungidziro yekuti chiedza i perpendicular, nzvimbo chete ndiyo inokosha uye nzira yemakwara haina basa.
y-m-69-09.s.s1.o.b: Kukwirira h kwaunosimudza divi repamusoro kubva pasi
y-m-69-09.s.s1.r.b: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti kurerekera kunogona kusarudzwa kubva pakukwirira nekureba kwe panel.
y-m-69-09.s.s1.r.c: Wakaunza ruzivo rwezuva nezuva rwekuti rumvuri runochinja nenguva. Dambudziko iri rinofungidzira kuti chiedza chezuva i perpendicular kupasi.
y-m-69-09.s.s1.o.d: Hukuru hwe angle yaunoita panel nepasi
y-m-69-09.s.s1.r.d: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti ruzivo urwu runoratidza mwero wekurerekera zvakananga.
y-m-69-09.s.s1.o.e: Dhuri repasi pakati pedivi repasi nedivi repamusoro rerumvuri
y-m-69-09.s.s1.r.e: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti divi re 3 m rerumvuri i divi rimwe chaizvo re orthogonal projection.
y-m-69-09.s.s1.explain: Area ye orthogonal projection inosarudzwa nedivi re 2 m rinoramba rakafanana nekureba kwarinovatwa divi re 3 m pasi. Kureba uku kunogona kuzivikanwa kubva pakukwirira h, angle yekurerekera, kana dhuri repasi rerumvuri. Nzira yemakwara nenguva hazvikanganisi S pasi pefungidziro yekuti chiedza i perpendicular.
y-m-69-09.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira makukwirira h 3 akasiyana apo area yerumvuri S i 4 m² kana kupfuura uye 5 m² kana kushoma. (S=2×√(9−h²); unogona kunyora ma decimals.)
y-m-69-09.s.s2.hint.0: Isa mitengo mishoma ye h mu S=2√(9−h²) uye uenzanise kana S iri pakati pe 4 ne 5.
y-m-69-09.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa mitengo miviri kufungidzira kwakaiswa range, uchicherechedza kuti S inochinja sei painokura h.
y-m-69-09.s.s2.fail.c1: h inofanira kuva hombe kupfuura 0 uye shoma kupfuura 3.
y-m-69-09.s.s2.fail.c2: S i shoma kupfuura 4. Edza kudzikisa h.
y-m-69-09.s.s2.fail.c3: S i hombe kupfuura 5. Edza kukwidza h.
y-m-69-09.s.s2.explain: Kana h=1.7, S≈4.94; kana h=2, S≈4.47; kana h=2.2, S≈4.08. Mitengo ye h inogutsa mamiriro iri murange inenge kubva ku 1.66 kusvika ku 2.23. Ngwarira kukanganisa kwekuverenga kumitengo iri padyo nemuganhu.
y-m-69-09.s.s3.prompt: Shamwari inoti, “Painonyanya kumisa panel (painonyanya kukura h), ndipo painonyanya kukura rumvuri.” Tonga kana izvi zvakarurama, uye unyore chikonzero uchishandisa nhamba.
y-m-69-09.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wawana kuti S i chii kana h=0.
y-m-69-09.s.s3.hint.1: Wana S kune h=1 ne h=2 uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-69-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaedza zviitiko zvakanyanyisa sa h=0 kana h padyo ne 3 here?
y-m-69-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa mitengo miviri yako ye h ne S kutarisa nzira here?
y-m-69-09.s.s3.model.0: Kwete. Kana h=0 panel inovata pasi uye rumvuri rwakakura zvikuru, 6 m²; kana h=2 i anenge 4.5 m²; uye painoswedera h ku 3 uye painonyanya kumira panel, ndipo painoswedera rumvuri ku 0. Saka painonyanya kukura h, ndipo painonyanya kudiki rumvuri.
y-m-69-09.s.s3.model.1: Zvakaipa. Kune h yangu ye 2, 2×√5≈4.47, asi kune h=1.7 i anenge 4.94, iyo i hombe. Kana h ichikura, area yerumvuri inova diki.

y-m-69-03.title: Kana tikapa maasymptotes chete, hyperbola yakasarudzwa here?
y-m-69-03.goal: Simbisa kuti pane mahyperbola akawanda ane maasymptotes akafanana, sarudza kuti ruzivo rwekuwedzera rupi rwunogadzika hukuru runodiwa kuti ugadzire hyperbola imwe chete, uye ugadzire wega maequation anokodzera mamiriro.
y-m-69-03.material: Pane hyperbola x²/a²−y²/b²=1 (verenga: x squared over a squared minus y squared over b squared equals 1; a>0, b>0) ine pakati paorigin uye axis huru (axis inobatanidza mavertices maviri) panzira ye x-axis. Maasymptotes maviri ehyperbola iyi i y=(3/4)x ne y=−(3/4)x. Yuniti yehurefu yakasiiwa.
y-m-69-03.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti nei isingasarudzwi kuita imwe chete
y-m-69-03.prereq.0: Kuva wakaona tsananguro yekutanga yechimiro x²/a²−y²/b²=1 cheequation yehyperbola nezvinoreva asymptote
y-m-69-03.s.s1.prompt: Kana ruzivo rwemaasymptotes roga rusingasarudze hyperbola imwe chete, sarudza zvidimbu zvose zveruzivo zvinotevera zvinogadzika, chimwe nechimwe chichiwedzerwa chega, hyperbola imwe chete.
y-m-69-03.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa, imwe neimwe, kana ruzivo rwatopiwa neruzivo rutsva zvine zvirimo zvakafanana.
y-m-69-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wafunga kana maasymptotes achisarudza 'ratio ye a ne b' kana 'hukuru hwe a ne b'.
y-m-69-03.s.s1.o.a: Unoziva hukuru hwekona pakati pemaasymptotes maviri
y-m-69-03.s.s1.r.a: Maasymptotes atopiwa, saka kona pakati pawo yatosarudzwa. Kunyora zvakare ruzivo rwaunotoziva nemamwe mashoko hakusi ruzivo rutsva.
y-m-69-03.s.s1.r.b: Poinzi iri pamukombe inogona kuiswa muequation kusarudza a. Wakaziva kuti poinzi imwe chete inogadzikawo hukuru.
y-m-69-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti nzvimbo yevertex inosarudza a zvakananga.
y-m-69-03.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinodzokorora ruzivo rwatopiwa, saka hapana ruzivo rutsva.
y-m-69-03.s.s1.r.e: Pfungwa iyi inoedza kugadzika hukuru uchishandisa chokwadi chekuti daro pakati pemafoci rakabatana ne a²+b².
y-m-69-03.s.s1.explain: Maasymptotes anosarudza ratio b/a=3/4 chete. Kana vertex i (4, 0), saka a=4 ne b=3. Kana daro pakati pemafoci i10, saka 2c=10 inopa c=5, uye kubva pa a²+b²=25 ne b=3a/4, a=4. Kuisa poinzi (8, 3√3) muequation kunopa a=4. Kutaura zvakare ruzivo rwemaasymptotes hakusi ruzivo rutsva.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.prompt: Muchimiro x²/A−y²/B=1 (A=a², B=b²), gadzira mahyperbola 3 akasiyana ane maasymptotes y=±(3/4)x. (A ne B dzakanaka; unogona kunyora madhesimali.)
y-m-69-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti chiyero 3/4 chemaasymptotes chinoreva hukama hupi pakati pe a ne b.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza a kutanga, gadzirisa b kuti ienderane, wobva wavawanza kaviri kuwana A ne B.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.fail.c1: A ne B zvinofanira kuva zvakakura kupfuura 0 zvose.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ongorora hukama pakati pe B ne A kuti b/a ive 3/4. (Kana b/a=3/4, hukama pakati pe 16B ne 9A hwuri hupi?)
y-m-69-03.s.s2.explain: Ne A=16, B=9; A=64, B=36; A=4, B=2.25, nezvimwewo, chero bedzi b=3a/4 maasymptotes ose akafanana. Sezvo a inogona kusarudzwa nemahara, pane mahyperbola akawanda zvisingaperi.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura nokupfupika kuti nei maasymptotes oga asingasarudze hyperbola imwe chete.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora a ne b yemahyperbola maviri awakagadzira pamusoro padivi nedivi.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora wega zvinosarudzwa neratio nehukuru imwe neimwe.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaongorora here kuti mumahyperbola ako matatu ratio ye a kuna b inogara yakafanana, 3:4?
y-m-69-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora musiyano pakati pe 'kuziva ratio chete' ne 'kuziva hukuru futi' nemashoko ako here?
y-m-69-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Maasymptotes anotiudza ratio b/a=3/4 chete, saka a=4, b=3 inoshanda uye a=8, b=6 inoshandawo. Nokuti tinogona kukwidza hukuru neratio imwe chete, pane mahyperbola akawanda. Tinoda ruzivo rwakawanda nezvehukuru, severtex kana focus.
y-m-69-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Chero bedzi chiyero chakafanana, kunyange kana tikakwidza a ne b nemultiple imwe chete maasymptotes anoramba akafanana, saka hyperbola imwe chete haina kusarudzwa. Tinoda ruzivo rwunogadzika hukuru.

y-m-69-05.title: Kutarisa mhinduro inotsvaga kona B yekatatu uchishandisa ma vector
y-m-69-05.goal: Mumhinduro inotsvaga kona imwe yomukati yekatatu uchishandisa dot product yema vector, tsvaga pakasarudzwa zvisizvo poinzi yokutanga yevector, tsvaga riini nzira iyi ichipa mhinduro yakarurama, uye utsvage kukosha kwakarurama.
y-m-69-05.material: Pacoordinate plane pane mapoinzi matatu A(1, 1), B(5, 1) ne C(6, 4). Vector AB ivector kubva ku A kuenda ku B. Seoyun akawana ∠B yekatatu ABC (kona inogadzirwa papoinzi B nemativi maviri BA ne BC) achishandisa dot product nenzira iyi.
y-m-69-05.prereq.0: Chimiro chema vector eplane, nevector inobatanidza mapoinzi maviri (AB=B−A)
y-m-69-05.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pe dot product nekona iri pakati pema vector, cosθ=(a·b)/(|a||b|)
y-m-69-05.prereq.2: Chokwadi chokuti kona yomukati yekatatu ikona iri pakati pemativi maviri anobuda pavertex apo anosangana
y-m-69-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe umo kukanganisa kunotanga mumhinduro yaSeoyun.
y-m-69-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti mutsetse wega wega unoverenga chii, uye utarise nomufananidzo kana kukosha uko ndiko kukosha kwa ∠B (kona papoinzi B).
y-m-69-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sketch zvakareruka mapoinzi A, B ne C ari kupi, uye utarise kana ∠B inoratidzika yakapinza kana yakapamhama.
y-m-69-05.s.s1.line.0: ∠B ikona inogadzirwa na AB ne BC, saka tinoshandisa AB=(4, 0), BC=(1, 3).
y-m-69-05.s.s1.explain: Kukanganisa kunotanga pamutsetse 1. ∠B ikona iri pakati pema vector maviri BA ne BC anobuda papoinzi B, asi Seoyun akashandisa AB, inobva ku A ichienda ku B. AB inonongedza nenzira yakapesana chaizvo na BA, saka kona iri pakati pe AB ne BC haisi ∠B asi chikamu chayo chinopedzisa (180°−∠B). Kuverenga kwe dot product nekureba pamutsetse 2 kwakarurama kuna AB ne BC, asi mutsetse 3 wakanganisa nokuti unodaidza kukosha uku cos∠B, uye 71.6° pamutsetse 4 mhedzisiro yakanganisawo.
y-m-69-05.s.s2.prompt: Kana ukatsvaga ∠B uchishandisa dot product ye AB ne BC sezvakaitwa naSeoyun, mukatatu rakaita sei umo ∠B inongobuda yakarurama?
y-m-69-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dhirowa katatu rakareruka (divi rimwe rakarara, rimwe rakamira) uye uenzanise zvakananga kana kona inogadzirwa nema vector maviri akashandiswa naSeoyun iri kona imwe chete ne ∠B.
y-m-69-05.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzira katatu rimwe ne ∠B yakaenzana ne 60° uchishandisa macoordinate, uye uenzanise kona inowanikwa nenzira yaSeoyun ne ∠B.
y-m-69-05.s.s2.r.a: Wakatenda kuti kona iri pakati pe AB ne BC ndiyo ∠B pachayo, saka wakafunga kuti yakarurama kana kona yakapinza.
y-m-69-05.s.s2.r.b: Wakaziva kuti kukosha kunochinja kana kona yakapamhama, asi wakashayikwa kuti kukosha kunochinjawo kumakona akapinza.
y-m-69-05.s.s2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kukosha kunowanikwa na AB ne BC kwakafanana ne ∠B, saka haina kuona kukanganisa mumhinduro.
y-m-69-05.s.s2.r.d: Wakashandisa chokwadi chokuti kona iri pakati pe AB ne BC chikamu chinopedzisa che ∠B.
y-m-69-05.s.s2.explain: Kona iri pakati pe AB ne BC ndi 180°−∠B. Kuti kona iyi ienzane ne ∠B, ∠B inofanira kuva 90°. Saka nzira yaSeoyun inongova yakarurama kana ∠B iri kona yakarurama.
y-m-69-05.s.s3.prompt: Tsvaga kukosha kwakarurama kwa ∠B (kusvika padhesimali rimwe) uye utsanangure mumitsara 1 kana 2 kuti mhinduro yaSeoyun yakanganisa papi.
y-m-69-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora iwe pachako ma vector maviri anotangira pa B.
y-m-69-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti unowana kukosha kupi kana ukawedzera kona yaSeoyun nekona chaiyo.
y-m-69-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatsvaga here zvakare dot product nekukosha kwe cos uchishandisa BA ne BC?
y-m-69-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti unowana chii kana ukawedzera kukosha kwaSeoyun 71.6° nekukosha kwako?

y-m-69-05.s.s3.model.2: ∠B inenge 108.4°. Seoyun akatora poinzi yokutanga yema vector zvisizvo uye akashandisa AB ne BC.

y-m-69-04.title: Kana madot products akaenzana, mavectors maviri akaenzanawo here?
y-m-69-04.goal: Ratidza necounterexample kuti chirevo 'kana a·b=a·c saka b=c' hachigari chichishanda, uye utaure kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera runodiwa kuti utaure b=c.
y-m-69-04.material: Seoa akati: “Kune vector isiri zero a nemavectors maviri b ne c, kana a·b=a·c saka b=c. Sezvakaita nenhamba, kana ab=ac uye a≠0 saka b=c, saka tinogona kudzima a kubva kumativi ose maviri.” Pano mavectors maplane (2-dimensional) vectors, uye ose akanyorwa nemacomponents.
y-m-69-04.thinking.0: Kutonga kana chirevo chiri chechokwadi kana chenhema
y-m-69-04.prereq.0: Chimiro checomponent cheplane vectors nekuverenga dot product nemacomponents (kune a=(a₁,a₂), b=(b₁,b₂), a·b=a₁b₁+a₂b₂)
y-m-69-04.prereq.1: Chokwadi chekuti dot product i0 kana mavectors maviri ari perpendicular
y-m-69-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvaunowana kana ukaunganidza equation 'a·b yakaenzana ne a·c' kudivi rimwe.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tora a sevector yakareruka zvikuru sa (1, 0) uye utarise kuti dot product inoverengwa sei kubva pamacomponents e b ne c.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.o.a: Yechokwadi. Sezvakaita nenhamba, unogona kudzima a kubva kumativi ose maviri kuwana b=c.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakauya nemutemo wekudzima kubva kukuwanza nhamba zvakananga kudot product. Dot product kuverenga kunogadzira nhamba imwe kubva kumavectors maviri, saka mutemo wekudzima ungasiyana.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.o.b: Yenhema. Kunyange kana madot products akaenzana, b ne c zvinogona kuva mavectors akasiyana.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa chokwadi chekuti chirevo che "nguva dzose" chinogona kuputswa necounterexample imwe chete.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.o.c: Yechokwadi. Kana madot products akaenzana, b ne c zvine hurefu hwakafanana uye nzira imwe chete.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.r.c: Dot product inhamba imwe chete, saka haitakure ruzivo rwose rwe b ne c. Nhamba imwe kuenzana hakureve kuti macomponents ose akaenzana.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.o.d: Yechokwadi chete kana |a|=|b|=|c|. Kana hurefu hwakaenzana, nzira dzinova dzakaenzanawo.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakaedza kununura chirevo nekuwedzera mamiriro. Hauna kuedza kana hurefu hwakaenzana huchikwana zvechokwadi.
y-m-69-04.s.s1.explain: Madot products akaenzana anongoreva a·(b−c)=0. Kunyange kana b−c isiri 0, mugumisiro i0 chero bedzi iri perpendicular ne a, saka tinogona kugadzira counterexample ine b≠c. Kunyange kana kutonga kwako kwekutanga kwakasiyana, unogona kukusimbisa nemuenzaniso waunogadzira pazasi.
y-m-69-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso miviri inopikisa chirevo chaSeoa. a haisi zero vector, uye unoda a·b=a·c apo b ne c zvakasiyana pakati pazvo. (a=(a₁, a₂), b=(b₁, b₂), c=(c₁, c₂))
y-m-69-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza a, wobva wawana vector d perpendicular ne a. Fungidzira kuti chii chinoitika kana musiyano kubva ku b kuenda ku c unonongedzera munzira ye d.
y-m-69-04.s.s2.hint.1: Munyaya yakareruka sa a=(1, 0), tarisa kuti component ipi ye b inosarudzwa ne dot product a·b.
y-m-69-04.s.s2.var.c2: Chikamu che y che c, c₂

y-m-69-04.s.s2.ok.k3: b ne c dzakasiyana nomumwe nomumwe.
y-m-69-04.s.s2.fail.k3: b ne c ndi vector imwe chete. Dzinofanira kuva ma vector akasiyana kuti ugadzire muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-69-04.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana a=(1, 0), b=(2, 1), c=(2, 5), saka a·b=2=a·c asi b≠c. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti b−c=(0, −4) yakananga kuna a, saka a·(b−c)=0. Chirevo chakanganisa kunyange kana paine muenzaniso mumwe chete unopikisa.
y-m-69-04.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuti muenzaniso wako unopikisa unokuudza sei 'zvaunofanira kuziva kuti utaure b=c'. Ndiko kuti, kunze kwa a·b=a·c, nyora ruzivo rumwe kana kupfuura rwaizoita kuti b=c.
y-m-69-04.s.s3.hint.1: Dhirowa mufananidzo wenyaya apo b−c isiri 0 asi a·(b−c)=0.

y-m-69-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakayedza here kamwe kana ruzivo rwokuwedzera rwawakataura runovimbisa chaizvo kuti b=c?
y-m-69-04.s.s3.model.0: a·b=a·c inoreva a·(b−c)=0, saka kana b−c yakananga kuna a, inoshanda kunyange b ne c dzakasiyana. Saka kuti utaure b=c, tinoda ruzivo rwokuwedzera runobvisa nyaya apo b−c yakananga kuna a, semuenzaniso mamiriro e d·b=d·c kune vector imwe d isingafanani na a.
y-m-69-04.s.s3.model.1: Madot product akaenzana oga haagoni kubvisa nyaya apo b−c yakananga kuna a. Kana tichiziva zvakare kuti b ne c zvose zviri pamutsetse mumwe na a, tinogona kutaura kuti b=c.
y-m-69-04.s.s3.model.2: Kana paine ruzivo rwokuti zvikamu zvakananga kuna a zvakaenzana, saka b=c. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti madot product akaenzana angangoreva kuti b−c yakananga kuna a.
y-m-69-04.s.s3.model.3: Kana b−c ichifanana na a, saka b=c. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti kana a·(b−c)=0 uye b−c ichifanana na a, saka b−c ivector zero.

y-m-69-10.title: Kana mutsetse unosangana ne parabola papoinzi imwe, i tangent here?
y-m-69-10.goal: Tarisa ne counterexample kuti mutsetse unosangana papoinzi imwe haugari uri tangent, gadzira iwe pachako ma tangent lines, uye utsanangure mamiriro apo nzira ye discriminant inoshandiswa.
y-m-69-10.material: Funga parabola y²=8x (verenga: y squared equals 8 x) nemutsetse y=mx+k. Mapoinzi ekusangana ezvimiro zviviri i mhinduro dze system ye equations, uye mutsetse kuva tangent ku parabola zvinoreva kuti zvimiro zviviri zvinosangana papoinzi imwe uye mutsetse hauyambuki curve papoinzi iyoyo. Kune denderedzwa, mutsetse unosangana nawo papoinzi imwe waiva tangent chaizvo. Eunchae akati: “Kune parabola zvakare, kana mutsetse unosangana nayo papoinzi imwe, mutsetse iwoyo i tangent.”
y-m-69-10.prereq.0: Discriminant ye quadratic equation (D=b²−4ac) nehuwandu hwema roots
y-m-69-10.prereq.1: Maitiro ekuwana kusangana kwemutsetse y=mx+k ne curve uchishandisa system ye equations
y-m-69-10.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa parabola y²=8x nemutsetse, uye utarise kuti huwandu hwemapoinzi ekusangana unochinja sei painochinja nzira yemutsetse.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.hint.1: Edza ma slopes akati wandei emutsetse, isa y=mx+k mu y²=8x, uye utarise kuti unowana equation yemhando ipi mu x.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.o.a: Yechokwadi. Sa denderedzwa, kana inosangana papoinzi imwe i tangent
y-m-69-10.s.s1.r.a: Wakatamisa property yedenderedzwa zvakananga kuna parabola. Parabola i curve yakavhurika, saka pangava nemamiriro akasiyana nedenderedzwa.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.o.b: Kana inosangana papoinzi imwe, discriminant ye quadratic equation yakabatanidzwa inogara i 0.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.r.b: Wakafungidzira kuti quadratic equation inobuda muzviitiko zvese apo inosangana papoinzi imwe. Hauna kufunga nezviitiko zvisiri quadratic.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.o.c: Yenhema. Tangent line inofanira kusangana ne curve pamapoinzi maviri.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.r.c: Tangent line i mutsetse unosangana ne curve papoinzi imwe chete, poinzi yekubata. Kana ukafunga kuti tangent inosangana pamapoinzi maviri, uri kusanganisa tangent ne secant.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.o.d: Yenhema. Mutsetse i parallel ne axis hauzi tangent kunyange kana unosangana ne parabola papoinzi imwe.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.r.d: Wakawana exception nekufunga mutsetse i parallel nenzira yekuvhurika kwe curve.
y-m-69-10.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse i parallel ne axis ye parabola (x-axis), sa y=k (k i constant), unosangana ne y²=8x papoinzi imwe chaizvo asi haisi tangent. Kubatanidza kunopa k²=8x, iyo i linear equation mu x, saka haugone kunyange kushandisa discriminant.
y-m-69-10.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mitsetse 3 y=mx+k (m≠0) i tangent ku parabola y²=8x ine ma slopes m akasiyana. (Shandisa discriminant kuwana hukama pakati pe m ne k. Unogona kunyora ma decimals, uye kukanganisa kudiki kwekutenderedza ma decimals (mukati me 0.01) kunobvumirwa.)
y-m-69-10.s.s2.hint.0: Isa y=mx+k mu y²=8x uye urongedze se quadratic equation mu x.
y-m-69-10.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mamiriro ekuti discriminant i 0 se expression mu m ne k, wobva wasarudza m kutanga uye ugadzirise k.
y-m-69-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana m=0 mutsetse i parallel ne axis, saka wabviswa mudhiziine iyi.
y-m-69-10.s.s2.ok.c2: Discriminant ye quadratic equation yakabatanidzwa i (padyo ne) 0, saka mutsetse i tangent.
y-m-69-10.s.s2.fail.c2: mk haisi 2, saka haisi tangent. Isa y=mx+k mu y²=8x uye utarise mamiriro ekuti discriminant i 0.
y-m-69-10.s.s2.explain: Kuisa y=mx+k mu y²=8x kunopa m²x²+(2mk−8)x+k²=0. Mamiriro ekuti discriminant D=(2mk−8)²−4m²k²=64−32mk i 0 i mk=2. (1, 2), (2, 1) ne (0.5, 4) zvose zvinogutsa mamiriro aya.
y-m-69-10.s.s3.prompt: Mutsetse y=k ne m=0 haugutsi mk=2 asi unosangana ne parabola papoinzi imwe. Tsanangura kuti sei nzira ye discriminant isingagone kushandiswa sezvayakaita muchiitiko ichi, uye kana i tangent kana kwete.
y-m-69-10.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kana term ye x² inooneka mu expression yaunowana.
y-m-69-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa zvakananga kuti expression inobva mukuisa y=k i e degree ipi mu x here?
y-m-69-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora nemashoko ako kuti 'inosangana papoinzi imwe' ne 'i tangent' zvinhu zvakasiyana here?
y-m-69-10.s.s3.model.0: Kuisa y=k kunopa k²=8x, iyo inosimbisa x semutengo mumwe, saka inosangana papoinzi imwe, asi expression i linear mu x, saka discriminant haigone kushandiswa. I mutsetse i parallel ne axis ye parabola, saka haisi tangent.
y-m-69-10.s.s3.model.1: Kana m=0, mu (0·x+k)²=8x term ye x² inonyangarika uye inova linear equation ine mhinduro imwe chete. Zvakadaro, i mutsetse i parallel ne axis, saka haisi tangent.

y-m-69-01.title: Mhinduro yaMinjae ye parabola yakakanganisa kupi?
y-m-69-01.goal: Wana mutsetse mumhinduro ye focus ne directrix ye parabola apo nzvimbo ye directrix inokanganisa, utarise uchishandisa definition (madhuri kuenda ku focus neku directrix akaenzana), uye ugadzire iwe pachako poinzi pa parabola imwechete.
y-m-69-01.material: Minjae akawana focus ne directrix ye parabola y²=−8x (verenga: y squared equals minus 8 x). Pa coordinate plane x-axis i yakarara uye y-axis i yakamira. Tarisa kana mutsetse wega wega wemhinduro uchitevera zvakarurama kubva pamutsetse wapfuura.

Poinzi (−2, 4) mumutsetse 4 chaizvo i pa curve. Asi dhuri kubva papoinzi iyi kuenda ku focus (−2, 0) i 4, uye dhuri kuenda ku directrix yaMinjae x=−2 i 0, izvo zvisingaenderani ne definition. y-m-69-01.s.s2.o.c: Isa poinzi (−2, 4) mu equation kutarisa kana iri pa curve
y-m-69-01.s.s2.r.c: Izvi zvinongosimbisa kuti poinzi iri pa curve; hazvigone kukuudza kana nzvimbo dze focus ne directrix dzakarurama.
y-m-69-01.s.s2.o.d: Tarisa kuti curve inovhurika kunzira ipi uye usarudze kuti directrix inofanira kuva kudivi ripi

y-m-69-01.s.s2.o.e: Tarisa zvakare kuti ma coordinates e focus ari pa x-axis
y-m-69-01.s.s2.r.e: Zvatoraramwa kuti focus i pa x-axis. Kutarisa zvakare mutsetse wakarurama hakuratidzi kukanganisa.
y-m-69-01.s.s2.explain: Kudzokera pamusoro papoinzi iri pamukombe uchishandisa tsananguro (madaro kufocus nekudirectrix akaenzana), nekuongorora kuti directrix iri padivi ripi kubva panzira yekuvhura, zvose zvinoratidza kukanganisa. y-m-69-01.s.s3.prompt: Fungidzira parabola y²=8x, ine directrix x=−2. Pakati pemapoinzi P(x, y) ari pamukombe, gadzira mapoinzi 3 umo x ne y zvose maintegers akanaka, ane kukosha kwe x kwakasiyana.
y-m-69-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kuti y ive integer mu y²=8x, fungidzira kuti 8x inofanira kuva nhamba yerudzi rupi.
y-m-69-01.s.s3.hint.1: Edza makosha madiki e x nenzira uye uwane nyaya umo 8x iri perfect square.

y-m-69-01.s.s3.fail.c2: Square ye y haienzani ne 8x. Poinzi haisi pamukombe.
y-m-69-01.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, (2, 4), (8, 8) ne (18, 12). Mapoinzi aya ane chimiro x=2k² ne y=4k. Madaro avo kufocus (2, 0) i4, 10 ne20, uye madaro kudirectrix x=−2 akafanana, saka anoenderana netsananguro. Unogonawo kuona kuti daro rinowanikwa nyore se x+2.

y-m-69-07.title: Mapoinzi ari panhambwe imwe kubva pamapoinzi maviri muchadenga anogadzira chimiro chipi?
y-m-69-07.topic: Mapoinzi ari panhambwe imwe kubva pamapoinzi maviri mumacoordinate echadenga
y-m-69-07.goal: Gadzira mienzaniso kuti uone kuti ruzivo rweplane (mapoinzi ari panhambwe imwe kubva pamapoinzi maviri anogadzira mutsetse) runochinja sei muchadenga, uye utonge chimiro nokutarisa kana mapoinzi awakagadzira ari pamutsetse mumwe.
y-m-69-07.material: Muplane, mapoinzi ari panhambwe imwe kubva pamapoinzi maviri A ne B akagadzira mutsetse wakananga unoparadzanisa chikamu AB pakati (mutsetse). Muchadenga pane mapoinzi maviri A(0, 0, 0) ne B(2, 4, 4), uye tinofunga mapoinzi P(x, y, z) anosangana na PA=PB. Chikamu chokureba chakasiiwa.
y-m-69-07.thinking.0: Kuyedza zvinoitika kana ruzivo rweplane rwakatamiswa kuchadenga
y-m-69-07.prereq.0: Fomula yechinhambwe pakati pemapoinzi maviri mumacoordinate echadenga √((x₁−x₂)²+(y₁−y₂)²+(z₁−z₂)²)
y-m-69-07.prereq.1: Chii chinonzi mutsetse wakananga unoparadzanisa chikamu pakati muplane
y-m-69-07.s.s1.prompt: Mapoinzi ose P muchadenga anosangana na PA=PB anogadzira chimiro chipi?
y-m-69-07.s.s1.hint.0: Rangarira kuti sei yaiva mutsetse muplane, uye uverenge kuti pane nzira dzingani dzakananga kuna AB muchadenga.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora PA²=PB² mumacoordinate uye utarise kuti chirevo chine chimiro chipi mushure mokuderedza.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakanzwisisa 'chinhambwe chakaenzana' muplane sepakati pamwe chete. Hauna kuyedza kana paine mamwe mapoinzi ari panhambwe imwe kunze kwepakati.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.o.b: Plane yakananga kuchikamu AB inopfuura nepakati pacho
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.b: Wakarangarira kuti mamiriro echinhambwe chakaenzana ndiyo vhezheni yechadenga yemutsetse wakananga unoparadzanisa pakati.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.o.c: Mutsetse mumwe unopfuura nepakati uye wakananga kuna AB
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakatakura ruzivo rweplane kuchadenga nokungowedzera coordinate imwe. Hausati wayedza kuti pane nzira dzakananga dzinopfuura imwe.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakavhiringidza 'chinhambwe chakaenzana kubva papoinzi imwe' (sifiya) ne 'chinhambwe chakaenzana kubva pamapoinzi maviri'.
y-m-69-07.s.s1.explain: Kuderedza PA²=PB² kunopa chirevo chimwe chemutsetse x+2y+2z=9. Seti yemapoinzi anosangana nechirevo ichi iplane. Ndiyo plane inopfuura nepakati (1, 2, 2) yakananga kunzira (2, 4, 4) ya AB.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapoinzi 3 akasiyana P(x, y, z) ane macoordinate ari nhamba dzizere anosangana na PA=PB.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga na P pakati pechikamu AB uye chinja coordinate imwe panguva imwe uchienzanisa zvinhambwe.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kana ukanyora sikweya yechinhambwe chega chega, uchiita kuti dzienzane, uye uderedze, unofanira kuona hukama pakati pemacoordinate.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.fail.c1: x, y ne z dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzizere dzose.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.ok.c2: PA ne PB zvakaenzana (masikweya azvo akaenzana).
y-m-69-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Masikweya e PA ne PB haaenzani. Verenga sikweya yechinhambwe kuenda kupoinzi yega yega uye uzvienzanise.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, (1, 2, 2), (3, 0, 3) ne (1, 4, 0). (1, 2, 2) ipakati pe A ne B. Mapoinzi aya ose anosangana na x+2y+2z=9. Kana ukatarisa kana mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe, unogona kutonga kana seti iyi imutsetse kana plane.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti ungatarisa sei kana mapoinzi ako matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe, uye unyore kuti izvi zvinowirirana kana kupikisana sei nepfungwa yekutanga yokuti 'imutsetse'.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora nzira inobatanidza mapoinzi maviri sevector uye uienzanise nenzira yepeya imwe.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kuti sei seti isingagoni kuva mutsetse kana mapoinzi matatu asiri pamutsetse mumwe.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga here zvakananga kana nzira dzinobva papoinzi imwe kuenda kune mamwe maviri dzakafanana?
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Kana mapoinzi ako matatu akangoitika ari pamutsetse mumwe, wakayedza here nemapoinzi akawanda?
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Vector (2,−2,1) kubva ku (1,2,2) kuenda ku (3,0,3) nevector (0,2,−2) kubva ku (1,2,2) kuenda ku (1,4,0) hazvifanani, saka mapoinzi matatu haasi pamutsetse mumwe. Saka seti yemapoinzi aya haigoni kuva mutsetse; iplane.
y-m-69-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana mapoinzi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe, nzira dzinobva papoinzi imwe kuenda kune mamwe maviri dzinofanira kuva dzakafanana kana dzakapesana, asi (1,2,2)→(3,0,3) ndi (2,−2,1) uye (1,2,2)→(1,4,0) ndi (0,2,−2), saka nzira dzakasiyana. Anogadzira plane, kwete mutsetse.

y-m-69-06.title: Unofanira kupfura nzira ipi kuti ugokorodze rwizi zvakananga?
y-m-69-06.goal: Tora kuyerera kwerwizi nokukurumidza kwechikepe sehuwandu hwema vector, gadzira ma vector okukurumidza akati wandei anosangana namamiriro, uye utonge kana chinangwa chimwe chete chigoneka kana kuyerera kuchichinja.
y-m-69-06.material: Rwizi runoyerera nenzira yakagadzikana kumabvazuva ne 3 m/s (kuchamhembe kuri kumusoro, kumabvazuva kurudyi). Chikepe chinogona kupfurwa nevector yokukurumidza v=(p, q) maererano nemvura (p chikamu chekumabvazuva, q chikamu chekuchamhembe, mu m/s), uye kukurumidza kwayo kukuru kuri 5 m/s, saka p²+q²≤25. Kukurumidza chaiko kwechikepe sokunoonekwa kubva pasi ndi v+(3, 0)=(p+3, q). Kutanga kubva kubhanga rekumaodzanyemba, unoda kusvika papoinzi iri kubhanga rekuchamhembe zvakananga mhiri. Fungidzira kuti kuyerera kwerwizi kwakagadzikana pasinei nenzvimbo nenguva.
y-m-69-06.thinking.1: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakati wandei pasi pemiganho
y-m-69-06.prereq.0: Kuwedzera ma vector eplane nechimiro chezvikamu
y-m-69-06.prereq.2: Nzira yokunyora kukurumidza sevector (zvikamu zviri pamusoro kumabvazuva nokuchamhembe)
y-m-69-06.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinoitika kana ukapfura chikepe kuchamhembe chaizvo nokukurumidza kukuru (v=(0, 5))?
y-m-69-06.s.s1.hint.0: Wedzera vector yokukurumidza kwechikepe nevector yokuyerera uye unyore kukurumidza chaiko muzvikamu.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana chikamu chekumabvazuva chokukurumidza chaiko chiri 0 kana kwete.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.o.a: Chikepe chinotakurwa kumabvazuva uye chinosvika kurudyi kwepoinzi iri mhiri zvakananga
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti rwizi runosunda chikepe kumabvazuva, saka kukurumidza chaiko kune chikamu chekumabvazuva.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.o.b: Chinosvika chaizvo papoinzi iri mhiri zvakananga
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti nzira yakananga chikepe ndiyo nzira yokufamba, uchisiya simba rokuyerera.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.o.c: Pasinei nenzira, inogara ichienda pasi pomuyerera chete
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakawedzera zvakanyanya simba rokuyerera uye wakaregeredza simba rokukurumidza kwokupfura.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakavhiringidza nzvimbo yepoinzi yokusvika neupamhi. Kuti chikepe chinosundwa kumabvazuva here kunosarudzwa pasinei neupamhi.
y-m-69-06.s.s1.explain: Kukurumidza chaiko ndi (0+3, 5)=(3, 5), ine chikamu chekumabvazuva chisiri 0. Saka pasinei neupamhi, chikepe chinosvika kumabvazuva kwepoinzi iri mhiri zvakananga. Upamhi hunongosarudza kuti chinotakurwa kure zvakadini.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma vector okukurumidza 3 v=(p, q) ane kukosha kwakasiyana kwa q anokubvumira kusvika papoinzi iri mhiri zvakananga. Mamiriro: chikamu chekumabvazuva chokukurumidza chaiko ndi 0, chikepe chinofamba kuchamhembe (q>0), uye hapana chinopfuura kukurumidza kukuru kwe 5 m/s.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora chikamu chekumabvazuva chokukurumidza chaiko nomuna p uye uchiite chienzane ne 0.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kana p yagadziriswa, nyora mamiriro okukurumidza pa q sekusaenzana uye utarise mhando inogoneka.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Unofanira kusarudza p kuti chikamu chekumabvazuva p+3 chokukurumidza chaiko chive 0.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.fail.c2: q inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 0 kuti chikepe chienda kubhanga rekuchamhembe.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.fail.c3: p²+q² yakakura kupfuura 25. Kukurumidza kukuru kwechikepe ndi 5 m/s.
y-m-69-06.s.s2.explain: p inofanira kuva −3 chaizvo kubvisa kuyerera kwe 3. Wobva kubva pa p²+q²≤25 tinowana q²≤16, saka 0<q≤4. Kana q=4, saka (−3, 4) ine kukurumidza kwe 5 chaizvo. Q ichidiki, chikepe chinogokorodza zvishoma nezvishoma.
y-m-69-06.s.s3.prompt: (1) Pakati pemhinduro dzawakagadzira, ndeipi inogokorodza rwizi nokukurumidza zvikuru, uye sei? (2) Kana rwizi runoyerera ne 6 m/s, chinangwa chimwe chete (kusvika mhiri zvakananga) chinogoneka here? Pindura nezvikonzero.
y-m-69-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ngati upamhi hwuve d uye ufunge d/q kuti uone zvinoitika kunguva apo chikamu chekuchamhembe chinokura.
y-m-69-06.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti p inofanira kuva chii kubvisa kuyerera, uye uyedze kana p iyoyo ichisangana namamiriro okukurumidza p²+q²≤25.
y-m-69-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa here 'chikamu chekuchamhembe' sechikonzero chokusarudza mhinduro inokurumidza zvikuru?
y-m-69-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kune 6 m/s, wakaenzanisa here kuti chikamu chekumadokero chinofanira kuva chikuru zvakadini nokukurumidza kukuru?
y-m-69-06.s.s3.model.0: (−3, 4) inokurumidza zvikuru. Chikamu chekuchamhembe q chikakura, nguva yokugokorodza inopfupika, uye q inogona kusvika ku 4. Kana kuyerera kuri 6 m/s, hazvigoneki. Kuti ubvise tinoda 6 m/s kumadokero, asi kukurumidza kukuru kwechikepe ndi 5 m/s, saka chikamu chekumadokero hachigoni kupfuura 5.
y-m-69-06.s.s3.model.1: Mhinduro ine q=4 inokurumidza zvikuru. Kuti usvike mhiri zvakananga tinoda p+3=0, uye q ichikura, kugokorodza kunokurumidza. Pa 6 m/s hatigoni kusvika mhiri zvakananga. Kuti uende pamusoro pekuyerera kwe 6 taizoda 6 kumadokero, asi kukurumidza kukuru ndi 5, saka chikepe chinogara chichitakurwa zvishoma.

y-m-69-08.title: Hukama hwakaita sei pakati pemitsetse miviri inofanana neplane?
y-m-69-08.goal: Ratidza nomuenzaniso wemitsetse isingasangani kuti chirevo chokuti 'mitsetse miviri inofanana neplane inosangana kana kufanana' hachishande, uye unongedze ruzivo rwokuwedzera runokubvumira kutaura kuti mitsetse miviri iri muplane imwe.
y-m-69-08.material: Muchadenga, plane α ndiyo xy-plane (z=0). Mutsetse unofanana na α unoreva kuti mutsetse haupo mu α uye hausangani na α. Sujin akati: “Mitsetse miviri inofanana na α yose iri padivi peplane imwe chete α, saka inogara ichisangana kana kufanana nomumwe nomumwe.” Muchadenga, mitsetse miviri isingafanani uye isingasangani inonzi iri 'munzvimbo yeskew'.
y-m-69-08.prereq.0: Nzvimbo dzemitsetse miviri mu space (inosangana, i parallel, kana i skew) uye zvinoreva mutsetse kuva parallel ne plane
y-m-69-08.prereq.1: Zvekutanga zvema space coordinates (x, y, z) nekunyora nzira yemutsetse se vector
y-m-69-08.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa mitsetse miviri i parallel ne α pamakukwirira akasiyana, uye ufunge kana mitsetse miviri ichisangana uye nzira dzayo dziri dzei.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti nzira dzemitsetse miviri dzinofanira kubatana sei kuti mitsetse ive parallel.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.o.a: Chakarurama. Zvose zviri parallel ne α, saka dzinosangana kana kuva parallel kune mumwe nemumwe.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandura "parallel ne plane imwechete" kuita "mitsetse miviri iri mu plane imwechete". Mitsetse miviri i parallel inogona kuva pamakukwirira akasiyana.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.o.b: Haisi nguva dzose. Pangava nezviitiko apo isingasangani uye isiri parallel.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga nezviitiko mu space apo mitsetse miviri isingasangani asi isiri parallel.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.o.c: Chakarurama. Mu space, mitsetse miviri inofanira kusangana kana kuva parallel.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakatamisa ruzivo rwako mu plane zvakananga kuenda ku space. Mu space, pane zviitiko apo mitsetse miviri isingasangani uye isiri parallel.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.o.d: Unofanira kuziva hukuru hwa α kuti utonge.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.r.d: Plane inotorwa seyakakura pasina muganhu, asi wakafunga nezve hukuru. Hukama hwenzvimbo hahuna chekuita nehukuru.
y-m-69-08.s.s1.explain: Kana mitsetse miviri i parallel ne α iri pamakukwirira akasiyana uye ine nzira dzakasiyana, i mu skew position. Gadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso wakadaro pazasi uye utarise.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya maviri emitsetse l ne m i parallel ne α (z=0) uye iri mu skew position nemumwe nemumwe. Mutsetse l unopfuura papoinzi (0, 0, h₁) ine nzira (a, b, 0), uye mutsetse m unopfuura papoinzi (0, 0, h₂) ine nzira (c, d, 0). Makukwirira haafaniri kuva pa α (0).
y-m-69-08.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti ungasarudza sei makukwirira kuti mitsetse miviri irege kusangana.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.hint.1: Edza mienzaniso mishoma yakapfava yenzira (a, b) ne (c, d) dzisiri parallel.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Makukwirira h₁ ne h₂ haafaniri kuva 0, kana mutsetse waizova mu α.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Nzira ye l haisi zero vector.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Nzira (a, b, 0) ye l haifaniri kuva zero vector.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Nzira ye m haisi zero vector.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Nzira (c, d, 0) ye m haifaniri kuva zero vector.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.fail.c4: Kana makukwirira akafanana, mitsetse yese mbiri iri mu plane imwechete z=h, saka inosangana kana kuva parallel. Edza makukwirira akasiyana.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.fail.c5: Nzira i parallel. (a, b) ne (c, d) hazvifaniri kuva parallel kune mumwe nemumwe kuti mitsetse ive skew.
y-m-69-08.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, l ine kukwirira 2 uye nzira (1, 0, 0), uye m ine kukwirira 1 uye nzira (1, 1, 0): mitsetse miviri ine z dzakasiyana saka haisangani, uye nzira hadzi parallel, saka iri mu skew position. Mitsetse yese mbiri ine z inogara iri imwechete, saka i parallel ne α.
y-m-69-08.s.s3.prompt: Kuwedzera pakuti mitsetse l ne m zvose i parallel ne plane α, sarudza ruzivo rwese runotevera runovimbisa 'mitsetse miviri iri mu plane imwechete'.
y-m-69-08.s.s3.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, edza kana unogona kugadzira muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro iwayo apo mitsetse miviri i skew.
y-m-69-08.s.s3.hint.1: Kana usingagone kugadzira muenzaniso, funga kuti mamiriro iwayo anoisa muganhu upi pamakukwirira nenzira dzemitsetse miviri.
y-m-69-08.s.s3.o.a: l ne m zvakamira perpendicular kune mumwe nemumwe (nzira dzavo i perpendicular)
y-m-69-08.s.s3.r.a: Wakafunga kuti mitsetse perpendicular iri mu plane imwechete. Kunewo mienzaniso yemitsetse i perpendicular uye skew.
y-m-69-08.s.s3.o.b: l ne m zviri kudivi rimwechete re α, pachinhambwe chakafanana kubva ku α

(Kana dziri pachinhambwe chakafanana kubva ku α asi kumativi akapesana e α, semuenzaniso pa z=1 ne z=−1, dzinogona kuva skew.) Mitsetse miviri inosangana kana i parallel iri mu plane imwechetewo. Kuti mitsetse miviri i perpendicular kana angle iri pakati payo yakasimbiswa zvinogonawo kuva zvechokwadi kumitsetse skew, saka hazvivimbise kuti iri mu plane imwechete.
